name: My Stepmum is a Vampire!
source:
It's been a little over a year since Ethan's father died... Until now, he had barely heard from his youthful looking stepmother: Victoria. Their relationship was always friendly enough. Victoria needs to travel for a while and has an unusual favor to ask, Would Ethan look after her family home while she's away?

It sounds simple enough. At least until Ethan arrives. Ethan always knew Victoria came from money, but he didn't realize she came from this much money! But on arrival things take a dark turn when Ethan discovers Victoria drinking what appears to be blood!

His Stepmum is a... Vampire?! Fangs. Blood. The whole thing. She quickly helps reassure him that she is no threat to him, in fact her travels are to find a cure for this supernatural disease. Unable to resist Victoria's charm you soon accept, as she departs she leaves you with just a simple warning... Don't go into the basement!

What happens next will be for you to decide as you make Ethan's decisions for him, what will this demon do to Ethan or want from him. 

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dharker/stepmum-vampire-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
